Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Dunedin for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from the Dunedin tree lighting (December 3) and Breakfast with Santa (December 5) through the Holiday Parade and Old Fashioned Christmas (December 12), with Santa's Calling (December 9) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Dunedin

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Dunedin
  • 5 free events, including Santa's Calling
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa (December 5) and Santa's Calling by phone (December 9)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Dunedin tree lighting (December 3), Holiday Boat Parade (December 5) and the Holiday Parade and Old Fashioned Christmas (December 12)
  • Trains: none in town
  • Season: December 3 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Dunedin families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Busch Gardens Christmas Town, ZooTampa Lights and the Tampa Riverwalk boat parade.
